description: This file defines a template class 'IteratorType' within the 'Thunder::RPC' namespace. The class provides an iterator implementation over a container, supporting various construction methods, iteration controls, and interface compliance. It is designed to be used as a base for iterators over different container types, with methods for navigation, resetting, and element access.
